meta.title: Lease coordination
meta.description: Coordination only: lets one agent claim a named piece of shared work (a lease) so two agents do not start the same job. A lease is a note other agents can read; it never blocks work by itself. When off: Lease tools are unavailable. A worker configured to require a lease cannot start: planning and entering Tower mode are refused with an explanation until that setting is cleared or this row is re-enabled. Everything else keeps working.
